summary: Zion Oil & Gas filed Amendment No. 2 to a December 11, 2024 prospectus supplement, extending the Unit Option window under its Dividend Reinvestment and Common Stock Purchase Plan from September 10 to September 25, 2026. Each $250.00 unit combines common stock, priced off the OTCQX high-low average on the purchase date, with 75 warrants exercisable at $0.75 from October 27, 2026 through April 27, 2027; ZNWBD warrants are unregistered and untraded. No board recommendation, advisor, minimum or maximum raise, or over-allotment is disclosed. This is a routine at-the-market-style plan takedown, not a special situation; watch dilution and warrant overhang.
